name: Colorgram
tagline: A free, open-source color logic puzzle game with no ads or tracking
blurb: Colorgram is a free and open-source picture logic puzzle game.
description:
Colorgram is a free and open-source picture logic puzzle game. Use numerical clues along the rows and columns to fill in grid tiles and reveal hidden colored pixel art images.

Key Features:

100% Free and Open Source (FOSS)

No advertisements, no microtransactions, and no tracking

Multiple grid sizes and difficulty levels
